subject: Skip building unit test files for integration test workflows (#942)
reason: The change only touches build tooling: CMakeLists.txt renames the BUILD_TESTS option to BUILD_UNIT_TESTS, build.sh passes the renamed flag and allows CMAKE_EXTRA_ARGS from the environment, and ci/build_ubuntu.sh disables unit-test compilation when a CI run executes integration tests only. No source file of the module (src/, vmsdk/, third_party usage) is modified, so the built libsearch.so and every command, reply, indexing path and persistence path are identical between the change and its parent. There is no runtime behaviour a scenario could reach or differentiate, so no scenario is needed.
